name: Reconcile
description: Level-triggered reconciliation of a tracker on a timer, with a watchdog timer beside it.

reconciler.description: Reads the tracker, compares it with what was last done, and closes the gap.
reconciler.instructions:
List the open items for the project. Compare with what you last did for this
project. Set the status of anything that has moved. Then write a heartbeat.

last-reconciled.description: what was last done, by project, so it is not done twice

every-quarter-hour.description: Reconcile each project with the tracker every fifteen minutes.
every-quarter-hour.says: Reconcile the project with the tracker.

watchdog.description: The dead man's switch. Checks that the reconciler has written a heartbeat lately.
watchdog.says:
Check that a heartbeat was written in the last hour. If none was, say so
loudly as your answer; a person reads the hourly report.

tracker-server.description: Where the team's issue tracker is reached.

tracker.description: The issue tracker, where desired state lives.

list-open.description: List the open items for one project.
